def feats(D,sp):
    h,w=len(D),len(D[0])
    sep=9 if sp==3 else 6
    rsep=[i for i in range(h) if all(x==sep for x in D[i])]
    csep=[j for j in range(w) if all(D[i][j]==sep for i in range(h))]
    R=runs(h,rsep);C=runs(w,csep)
    out=[]
    for (r0,r1) in R:
        for (c0,c1) in C:
            pos=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if D[r][c]==sp]
            out.append(pos)
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    rsep=[i for i in range(h) if len(set(grid[i]))==1]
    csep=[j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1]
    def runs(n,sps):
        rs=[];s=0
        for p in sps+[n]:
            if p>s: rs.append((s,p))
            s=p+1
        return rs
    R=runs(h,rsep);C=runs(w,csep)
    sepv={grid[i][0] for i in rsep}|{grid[0][j] for j in csep}
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    bg=max((c for c in cnt if c not in sepv),key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    sp=[c for c in cnt if c not in sepv and c!=bg][0]
